showcase.subtitle: Decodable phonics books for children aged 4-8
showcase.tagline: Every book is a window into a different contemporary culture

values.mission: Every child deserves a reading book matched to exactly what they can decode today.
values.tagline: Decodable phonics books. Print at home.
values.voice: Warm, encouraging, like a friendly Year 1 teacher. British English. Never salesy.
values.target: Parents of 4-8 year olds, British expats, international schools.
values.artStyle: Whimsical hand-drawn cartoon with soft watercolour backgrounds, clean black outlines, solid black dot eyes.
values.curriculum: Based on Letters and Sounds (UK). 6 levels, 32 books, progressive phonics.
values.fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans (web), Outfit (headings), Andika (books — single-storey a and g).
values.differentiator: Every word decodable + genuine cultural diversity + print at home.

showcase.readerBody: Browse the full library with interactive word-by-word reading, audio narration, and phonics activities.
showcase.footer: MyPhonicsBooks — Based on Letters and Sounds (DfE 2007). Not affiliated with Read Write Inc or Oxford Reading Tree.
